title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (8/20): Heat Wave in Linhai
note_en: The pattern 需要 + time + 才能 + verb says how long must pass before something becomes possible: 至少需要两年才能建成 "it would take at least two years to build" (literally "needs two years, only then can it be built"). 才 means "not until then," so the Chinese stresses that it can't happen any sooner, which English expresses with "take" or "not until."
